The heldSpells lane already covers non-wand items of exactly this kind (firestarter-pellets holds fireball, noxious-incense holds wall-of-fire). Rank 3 is printed explicitly; the knocked-prone rider is target-side.

Activation casts shatter on an unattended object once per day; the record holds no spell, so the casting is invisible on the sheet. shatter is rank 2 in core.spells. The Hardness-ignoring rider is object/GM side.

The activation is a bespoke frightened aura (frightened 1, or 2 on a critical failure, floor of 1 while ringing) landing only on other creatures. It is not the fear spell (different degrees of success) and no rank is printed, so there is no spell to hold and no owner-side number to change.

Touching the chime grants the target, which may be you, the effects of sanctuary (rank 1), and it has five uses per day; the record carries neither the spell nor any use limit, so the item is wholly inert. heldSpells is the established lane for touch items conferring a named spell (healers-gel-lesser holds heal).

The first 2 Bulk of items stowed in the chair not counting against your Bulk limit is the backpack effect, and the record carries no storage data at all, so the encumbrance relief never happens. backpack ships capacity {"bulk":4} plus ignoredBulk 2, and all 46 storage items in core.json use ignoredBulk, so 2 is the exact printed value.

Its clauses are a GM-adjudicated carrying capacity, Interact actions to raise or place it, and a tip-over check on Release; the encumbered condition while pushing is applied by the player in play, not a standing item effect.
The base wheelchair entry is descriptive: it prints no Speed, no bonus and no penalty. The mechanical variants (travelers, supramarine, land-delvers chairs) are separate records.
